name: Facet
text: Make the legend a sticky panel anchored to the left edge of the graph, always visible. This keeps the meaning of colors and symbols in the user’s field of view without forcing them to hunt for a tooltip or click a button. The trade-off is that the graph area shrinks slightly, but clarity and speed of understanding win—users won’t pause to decode the chart.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A sticky legend still risks crowding the graph when users zoom into dense data clusters—controls vanish under the legend’s shadow. Better: a floating legend that collapses into a compact icon when space tightens, expanding only on hover or tap. Settle it with A/B tests measuring task completion time and user-reported clarity under zoom.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A floating legend that collapses on zoom still risks users missing the icon in a cluttered view—what if the collapse state blends into the graph’s noise? Better: a persistent, minimalist legend bar that auto-truncates labels and stacks vertically when space tightens, keeping all controls visible without hover delays. Settle it with A/B tests measuring how often users reopen the legend versus how quickly they complete tasks.
